verdict.rationale: Smithery's docs describe a managed OAuth model: it handles OAuth flows and maintains its own OAuth apps for popular integrations, so users configure no client IDs or secrets. Nothing in the evidence shows custom branding of the authorization flow or bringing your own OAuth app credentials. The axis applies to a connection and credential platform, so the absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials
